name: HEDISCoreProcedure
title: HEDIS Core Procedure
description: The HEDIS Core Procedure profile extends the US Core requirements to include requirements for measure calculation.

element.definition: [HEDIS] The metadata about a resource. This is content in the resource that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.
[US Core] A code specifying the state of the procedure. Generally, this will be the in-progress or completed state.
[US Core] The specific procedure that is performed. Use text if the exact nature of the procedure cannot be coded (e.g. "Laparoscopic Appendectomy").
[HEDIS][US Core] The person, animal or group on which the procedure was performed.

[US Core] Estimated or actual date, date-time, period, or age when the procedure was performed.  Allows a period to support complex procedures that span more than one date, and also allows for the length of the procedure to be captured.
[HEDIS] Detailed and structured anatomical location information. Multiple locations are allowed - e.g. multiple punch biopsies of a lesion.
